evidence.quote:
Sundays Beach Club – Uluwatu Beach Club Bali
Bali's Best Day on the Beach
OPEN DAILY FROM 7:30 AM TO 10 PM
evidence.note: Official site live today; footer address 'Jalan Pantai Selatan Gau Banjar Wijaya Kusuma Ungasan 80362'; part of The Ungasan Clifftop Resort.

claims.live_value: Sundays Beach Club
claims.quote: © Copyright Sundays Beach Club 2026

claims.live_value: A private white-sand cove at the foot of the Ungasan cliffs — the Bukit's one true toes-in-the-sand beach club.
claims.quote: Below the cliffs, guests have exclusive access to the celebrated Sundays Beach Club, where white sand, calm waters and relaxed dining create the perfect coastal escape.
claims.note: First half (white-sand cove below the Ungasan cliffs, resort-private access) is supported by the quote. 'the Bukit's one true toes-in-the-sand beach club' is a comparative superlative about competitors that no official source can support — removal candidate for that clause only.

claims.live_value: Most 'beach clubs' on this peninsula sit on cliffs.
claims.note: Editorial context about other venues; no quality warning.

claims.live_value: Sundays actually gets you onto the sand: a funicular carries you down to a sheltered lagoon with daybeds, watersports and evening bonfires.
claims.quote: Your journey to the water’s edge at Sundays is as spectacular as the destination itself thanks to our custom inclinator lift.
claims.note: Official term is 'inclinator', not 'funicular'. Lagoon: 'Explore the crystal clear lagoon'; bonfires: 'We fire up our beach bonfires daily at sunset'; daybeds: 'Beyond the shade of our daybeds' (social caption on the official page); walk-in pass includes 'Bean Bag & Beach Umbrella on the Sand'.

claims.live_value: For families and beach days it is the district's clearest answer.
claims.note: Fit judgement; pass page lists 'Kids Painting & Activities' and child pricing.

claims.live_value: Entry works as a daily beach pass with food-and-drink credit.
claims.quote:
7.30am to 10pm – Daily Beach Pass Includes:
Entry via Inclinator Ride
Welcome Drink upon Arrival
Bean Bag & Beach Umbrella on the Sand
Food & Beverage Credit

claims.live_value: Below the cliff you get calm, swimmable water (tide-dependent), kayaks and snorkelling gear, a beachfront kitchen, and bonfires after sunset.
claims.quote: Kayaks, stand up paddle boards, snorkeling or swimming – everything you need is on us. Subject to tides and availability.
claims.note: Bonfires: 'We fire up our beach bonfires daily at sunset ... Daily from 6:30 PM.' Kitchen/dining: 'From our ocean-view bar to your spot on the sand'.

claims.live_value: It is part of The Ungasan resort; the ride down is half the fun.
claims.quote:
The Ungasan Clifftop Resort
Luxury Villas
claims.note: 'Below the cliffs, guests have exclusive access to the celebrated Sundays Beach Club' on the same page. Second clause is editorial tone.

claims.live_value: Beach access is via the resort's inclinator from the clifftop.
claims.quote: Entry via Inclinator Ride

claims.live_value: Check tides for swimming.
claims.quote: Bean bag availability and Watersports are tide dependent.
claims.note: Official site also publishes a monthly Tide Chart page.

claims.live_value: Daily beach passes are walk-in; cabanas and VIP set-ups are pre-booked.
claims.quote: Daily Beach Passes are always available via walk-in general admission. You can also pre-book a VIP Experience with reserved spaces and premium inclusions for a more personalised day.
claims.note: Official VIP tiers are named Sundecks / Bungalow / Beach house, not 'cabanas'. VIP booking runs through SevenRooms links on the official page.

claims.live_value: beach days with kids; sunset bonfires; couples who want sand, not concrete
a quick cheap stop — the pass model rewards staying the day
claims.note: Fit context only; pass pricing on the official page (adults IDR 800K) supports it.

claims.live_value: mahi mahi tacos; BBQ lobster; wood-fired pizza
claims.proposed: crispy mahi mahi taco; bbq whole lobster; woodfired pizza
claims.quote: crispy mahi mahi taco + black pepper cabbage + avocado + hot sauce
claims.note: All three exist on the June 2026 menu PDF: 'crispy mahi mahi taco', BBQ section 'whole lobster + xo chilli butter + lemon', 'WOODFIRED PIZZ A' section. The live card currently renders whatToOrder as null although the registry holds these values. PDF is on the official domain; the site's 'View Menus' button goes to linktr.ee/sundaysmenu (link-tree, not used).

claims.quote:
Adults

Menu PDF prints prices 'in thousands of rupiah' with BBQ mains and pizzas in the 185–1,200 range, but the PDF text extraction separates prices from item names so a single item→price pair cannot be quoted verbatim.
